key_insight: The paper proposes stochastic first- and zeroth-order optimization methods for training on a mix of ground-truth and potentially incorrect ML-generated labels.
engineering_relevance: This approach could reduce dependence on costly human labeling when scaling model training.
method: Combine samples with ground-truth labels and samples labeled by an ML predictor.
Develop stochastic first-order optimization methods for mixed-label training.
Develop stochastic zeroth-order optimization methods for the same setting.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports empirical studies ranging from linear regression training to LLM fine-tuning, but provides no quantitative results.
watch_item: Robustness to different rates and patterns of ML-label errors is not specified in the abstract.
paper_title: Training with ML-labeled Data via Stochastic First- and Zeroth-Order Optimization
